text: Squatting every leg day... but the back of your legs still looks flat?
In a squat, your knees bend a lot. So the front of your thighs, your quads, do most of the work.
In a Romanian deadlift, your knees stay soft and your hips push back. That stretches your hamstrings and glutes.
Simple rule. Bend at the knees, quads. Hinge at the hips, hamstrings.
Do one of each, every leg day. Save this.
